title: Integrate 37 corrective work orders with bounded qualification
body:
This Draft PR joins all37 corrective work orders; all37 and all eight joins are QUALIFIED under their bounded contracts. Genuine native hidden→visible recovery closes R0025/J07/J08 on unchanged source. The repaired Sun enters low-left with a defined warm-white nucleus; the cool weighted PBR shadow floor makes the gibbous dark limb textured while preserving phase balance and the original Earthshine curve. Glass remains default, current outlined, next tinted, future visible and only actually elapsed ordinary rows faded; progress stays visible. Model-only strong precipitation remains withheld and physical lunar light stays separate from opaque calendar presence.

One owned Windows Chrome document used genuine tab activation with forced-focus emulation disabled. Two trusted document.hidden→visible cycles lasted55.485s and3.0781s. Phase, life, wander, key and population held exactly; the first hidden interval retained67 cloud paints/5 renders. The first resumed actual render starts5.7ms after return and integrates7.5ms, excluding the hidden backlog. Unmodified cloud stills separated29.3001s show leftward travel and shape evolution. A30s admitted synthetic rain lease expires while hidden; its first resumed actual render changes rain to cloud and rain opacity.720→.000. The installed record remains unavailable instead of reverting to plain-preview rain. This is explicit motion=full with declared1x running-controlled civil Date and native performance elapsed, not live observed precipitation. The first visible event interval47.7969s, travel-state read47.6523s, image captures and painter timestamps are distinct. Child drop opacity may remain positive under the parent display gate; the painter’s earlier rainTiedFx snapshot precedes the loop’s subsequent tieRainToClouds clearing. Coalesced15s/45s labels, prior ineffective freeze/focus routes, trajectory gaps/timer race, reduced/seek scope, art/cost approximations and the ordinary61s clear-breathing residual stay recorded. No continuous120s clip, hidden-pixel/first-compositor proof, all-browser/night matrix or global M0 upgrade follows. Owner’s installer amendment remains actual Git for Windows Bash with controlled Linux fixtures and native Linux behavior in WSL; Bash3.2 language/source restrictions and separate PowerShell5.1/7 gates stay fixed. No Apple interpreter or NTFS equivalence is claimed.

The [37-row/eight-join dossier](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/205750350c64b77ebdc3ebcadcc39a6eb949994b/docs/rlgwo-implementation-dossier.md), [bounded current receipts and actual reviewers](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/205750350c64b77ebdc3ebcadcc39a6eb949994b/docs/evidence/rlgwo/receipts/continuation-native.md#current-runtime6695-qualification), and [three final-source original images](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/205750350c64b77ebdc3ebcadcc39a6eb949994b/docs/evidence/rlgwo/receipts/continuation-native.md#runtime6695-original-images) bind runtime6695/index4f. The [genuine hidden receipt](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/205750350c64b77ebdc3ebcadcc39a6eb949994b/docs/evidence/rlgwo/receipts/continuation-native.md#r0025-hidden-native) records the source-unchanged final cell. Previous daa42/36–1 and all earlier cuts remain historical. Only R0025’s deferred template changes from r33; the other36 remain byte-identical. Owner review applies only to the new final documentation/publication HEAD after readback.

The bounded native measurements retain an increase. After 24 warmups, 121 cached batches of 32 calls have median/p95 7.8/10.5 → 10.8/13.5 ms per batch; 21 material misses after 8 warmups have joined 8.4/9.4 → 11.6/13.1 ms and nested PBR 7.8/8.9 → 8.4/9.4 ms. Both documents use fixed Madinah 22:00/cloud55 at DPR 1.37; readiness ages differ 390.819/37.191 s. All 32 input actions and references restore. Positive/noop has zero rasters; each same-phase up transition has one raster, below light is zero and healthy positive returns. The measured synchronous model→renderMoon→atmosphere→paint/PBR path includes changed geometry/raster work. Serial order, document age, observer overhead and roughly 0.1 ms quantization limit causal attribution. No efficiency, GPU/compositor completion, battery, long-run leak, startup/fallback cost or new motion claim follows.

The native controls and five authored sceptic scopes are bounded and share Root captures. Subtle lunar contrast, low-sun growing/clipped footprint, debug overlay/pre-paint text, helper-font acquisition, early truthful pending and historical motion limits remain disclosed. There is no full art/M0, owner approval, campaign completion, efficiency/GPU/battery/leak or deployment claim.
